ValidationRule.description: Prevents users from changing status for 'ID Ops Assistance' Case from any of the Closed statuses: 'Equifax Passed', 'Failed (OK)' or 'Confirmed Fraud'
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c ), RecordType.DeveloperName = "ID_Ops_Assistance", OR( ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE( Status ), "Equifax Passed"), ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE( Status ), "Failed (OK)"), ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE( Status ), "Confirmed Fraud") ), ISCHANGED( Status ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You are not allowed to change status from either 'Equifax Passed', 'Failed (OK)' or 'Confirmed Fraud' statuses
